desc: Derive the precise feasibility condition: feasible iff (R even and R≥2) or (R=0 and B even). Matches samples.
Design construction for all-red case (B=0, R even): R=2 → adjacent pair; R≥4 even → 2×k rectangle perimeter.
Design construction for all-blue case (R=0, B even): two diagonal legs forming a loop.

Design clean mixed-case construction (R even ≥2, any B≥1): red skeleton 2×k rectangle + single blue detour between vertical pair (2,k+1)-(3,k+1); explicit gadgets for B=1..4, out-and-back zigzag for B≥5; verified by brute-force checker.
Rewrite the solution code from scratch with the clean construction (replace convoluted build_detour); implement per-test-case O(R+B) output, fast I/O.

Verify final code against sample (2 3 → Yes, 1 1 → No, 4 0 → Yes) and edge cases (R=0 B=2, R=0 B=4, R=2 B=0, R=2 B=1, R=2 B=5, large R+B) with an independent brute-force checker validating distinct squares, per-piece move adjacency including last→first, and piece counts.
